title: the panel's login page, contract version 1
description: The props of the panel's login page (PRD 5.16, 13.4), Auth/Login in js/panel. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\LoginPage, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

action.description: The address the form posts to.

forgot.description: The address of the page that asks for a password reset link.

reason.description: Why the panel sent the browser to this page, or null when it did not: required (the request carried no session), expired, ended, revoked, signed_out or password_changed.

refusals.description: The catalog code of the refusal of the login just posted, under the field it is about, or under form for the login as a whole; null where there is none.

refusal.description: A catalog code a login is refused with: validation_required for a field left empty, login_rejected for an unknown email, a wrong password and a login the policy refused alike, and login_rate_limited.

refusals.description: The refusals of a login, by the field they are about.

email.description: The refusal about the email, or null.

form.description: The refusal about the login as a whole, or null.

password.description: The refusal about the password, or null.
